_doc: Model-family presets used with --preset (or art_style.preset in sdv-project.json). They fill prompt and sampler defaults for a checkpoint family; the owner's locked art_style always wins.

illustrious.quality: masterpiece, best quality, amazing quality, very aesthetic
illustrious.negative: lowres, worst quality, bad quality, bad anatomy, bad hands, jpeg artifacts, signature, watermark, text, cropped, multiple views, out of frame, detailed background, scenery

pony.negative: score_6, score_5, score_4, lowres, bad anatomy, bad hands, jpeg artifacts, signature, watermark, text, cropped, multiple views, out of frame, detailed background, scenery

_framing.portrait: solo, portrait, upper body, close-up, head and shoulders, looking at viewer, facing viewer, centered, simple background, white background
_framing.reference_sheet: multiple views, reference sheet, character sheet, turnaround, front view, side view, back view, full body, standing, simple background, white background
_framing.sprite: multiple views, reference sheet, same character, solo, simple background, white background, full body, standing
_framing.sprite_style: pixel art, game sprite, chibi, simple shading, clean outlines

_emotions.happy: smile, happy, open mouth, bright eyes
_emotions.sad: sad, frown, downcast eyes, teary eyes
_emotions.unique: smug, one eyebrow raised, confident smirk
_emotions.love: blush, shy smile, half-closed eyes, embarrassed
_emotions.angry: angry, frown, furrowed brow, v-shaped eyebrows, clenched teeth
_emotions.surprised: surprised, wide eyes, open mouth, raised eyebrows
_emotions.laughing: laughing, eyes closed, open mouth, big smile
_emotions.thinking: thinking, hand on chin, looking up, pensive

_directions.right: from side, right side view, facing right
_directions.left: from side, left side view, facing left
